method: Exact SHA-256 comparisons against current asset and frozen restoration records, original removed-file ledger, and recorded capture/source matches. Original project inventory reconciled with current publication allowlist. Asset renaming is not treated as evidence of independent creation. Specific source grants, source review and functionality results remain in the linked review records.
limits: Engineering verification only. It neither guarantees legal clearance nor removes historical commits, provider artifacts, forks or external recordings.

release.format: Biome2.5.0 checked37 tooling, configuration and compliance files with no changes required.

publication_verification.artifact_packaging_omission: .nojekyll is excluded by the pinned upload-pages-artifact action default hidden-file filter; all other allowlist and reference checks passed. The file is a build marker, not required content in this workflow-based Pages deployment.

dependency_followup.purpose: Reject dependency lock version/license/origin drift and missing or uncertain provenance through the existing safeguards; actual upstream licenses require manual inspection.
